description_raw: Fold-over phone case made from premium synthetic leather. It has a wrist strap, three card slots, RFID-shielding material, an inner mirror, and a kickstand for hands-free viewing.
Reusable 650 ml bottle with a stainless-steel inner wall and a powder-coated exterior. The screw cap has a silicone seal and a loop for carrying.
Compact wireless earbuds supplied with a charging case. Each earbud has a microphone and touch controls; the case recharges the earbuds over USB-C.
Kitchen blender with a 1.5 litre glass jar, stainless-steel blades, two speed settings, and a pulse function. Removable parts can be washed separately.
Everyday backpack made from recycled polyester with a padded sleeve for laptops up to 15 inches, two side pockets, and an adjustable chest strap.
